cond_0386.intro: We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer II (Deposition) to join our team.
cond_0386.responsibilities:
Install and qualify new process equipment. Own day-to-day troubleshooting of manufacturing issues on the production line in a timely manner, including tool down issues, yield, and quality issues, and determine actions to prevent repeat issues. Identify and execute system improvements that contribute to throughput, yield, and product performance goals.
Essential Responsibilities
Develop, continuously improve, and document robust solar module manufacturing processes to achieve the highest product performance in a cost-efficient manner
Drive manufacturing requirements into new process development by leading collaboration with the development team
Design and execute experiments to establish manufacturing process windows
Own resolution of day-to-day production, equipment, and process problems
Evaluate, install, and qualify new equipment
Design and execute planned process experiments, collect and analyze data, and report experimental results
Take ownership of data collection relating to daily equipment performance and associated product performance
Direct interfaces with internal associates and supplier representatives as required to complete assigned projects
Maintain effective communication with production associates and manufacturing engineers
Set up new gauges and perform gauge maintenance
Develop and deliver training to other engineers, engineering technicians, and production associates
Champion continuous improvement activities using six-sigma and other statistical problem-solving methods
Provide mentorship to junior engineers and technicians
Develop Process Control Plans and Preventive Maintenance Plans
Execute work with minimal supervision
Adhere to all safety procedures and good housekeeping standards
Domestic and international travel as required
Develop and maintain drawings, process specifications, and standard operating procedures
Perform data collection relating to daily equipment performance and associated product performance
Other duties as assigned
Reporting Relationships
Job description subject to change at any time
Reports to Manager, Manufacturing Engineering Deposition
This position may have direct reports
Travel
Domestic and international travel as required

Work with the team to develop and maintain drawings, process specifications, and standard operating procedures.
Other duties as assigned.
